answer: Admission auctions pit fake identities against each other. Top 500 bids win per epoch, so chasing 100 slots lifts the farmer's own price. The violet board prices demand. Idle slots stay hollow, voteless till tasks complete; honest holders earn the nectar of rewards. Cost ledger: 100 fakes mean 100 rising bids and 20-epoch lockup; fakes burn 40% of deposits. Splinter bids fail: slots bind to the bidding key, so bought accounts stay hollow.
